before_conditions: The TrailsRouter contract has an injectAndCall() function.
The injectAndCall() function does not have the onlyDelegatecall modifier.
The project invariant states that Router/RouterShim functions execute only via delegatecall from a Sequence v3 wallet context and any direct call must revert via onlyDelegatecall.
The test suite intentionally calls these functions directly and expects them to succeed.
No tests enforce or expect delegatecall-only behavior.
required_property: All Router/RouterShim functions, including injectAndCall() and injectSweepAndCall, must execute only via delegatecall from a Sequence v3 wallet context, and any direct call must revert via the onlyDelegatecall modifier, protecting the expected execution context and storage of the Sequence wallet.
bad_outcome: Direct calls to injectAndCall() succeed instead of reverting, causing the function to read/write from the Router contract's own storage instead of the Sequence wallet storage, breaking the expected execution context and violating the invariant.
